{{Quote|Note to self: see a medic. Blasted risp bit a chunk out of my leg. Mantellian whisky eases the burn, but i'm down to my last bottle&hellip; Bad time to get sick. Passengers going crazy, no ear plugs-and either I've got another fever dream, or the risp's looking strange.|Zama Brak|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Zama Brak''' was a [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]-era [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] that unwittingly started the [[rakghoul pandemic]], after agreeing to smuggle an infected [[risp]] for Doctor [[Sannus Lorrick]] aboard the passenger liner, the ''[[Stardream]]'', beginning the outbreak.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Brak was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' world event, where both players of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] could uncover a series of journal entries of various passengers and crew aboard the Stardream.
